_comment: SYNTHETIC. What the INTAKE CALLER supplies for the populated synthetic onboarding form (documents/SYNTHETIC_onboarding_form_2026_populated.docx, fictional employee 'Omar Synthetic') when it is run against the shared dev project: the form-approval attestation, the placement location (never read from the document, decision D3), and the UC-02 fields UC-01 does not carry (role_id, manager_id, location, project, opt-in checklist attributes). UC-02 never infers attributes; the ones listed are those the form itself supports (visa from outside the country, annual tickets, hotel stay, insurance). No background-verification attribute is listed because the form does not state one. role_id 'data_engineer' is the caller's choice from the roles SYN-UAE-TEST's approved UC-02 configuration knows. Department and grade are deliberately absent: UC-01 takes them from the document. 'project' is null ON PURPOSE: the onboarding form has no project field, the employee record's project_name is empty and SYN-UAE-TEST's approved UC-02 configuration names no project, so there is no source for it. The handoff stops with HR_INPUT_REQUIRED ['project'] before calling UC-02 until HR supplies one here (or in the placement); no value is invented.
